component.name: Supercharge Studio
component.summary: Desktop studio for the Supercharge coding agent

description.p: Supercharge Studio is an open-source desktop app for the Supercharge coding agent. It talks to the agent over ACP and gives you chat sessions, plans you can approve, a file tree, multiple terminals and browser tools in one window.

ul.li: Chat with the agent, steer it mid-task and review plans before they run
Sessions stay in sync with the Supercharge CLI
Pair your phone with a QR code over an end-to-end encrypted connection, locally or through a relay
Upload files and keep the app running in the tray

description.p: AI cursor in the side browser: when the agent browses, its own cursor glides to each click, type and scroll with a click ripple and a "Supercharge is browsing" label, and moving your own mouse takes over. Also fixes the Linux CI app smoke check. The AI cursor has not been tested on macOS or Windows yet; please report any issues.

Background mode on Android: while a turn runs the phone stays connected and an ongoing notification shows what the agent is doing (thinking, running a tool, editing a file, waiting for approval with Allow and Deny), then says when it is done. The thinking block opens while the agent thinks and folds to "Thought for Ns", the phone's jump-to-latest button goes all the way to the newest message, and the thinking level picker works in the app. Background mode has only been tested locally and on an Android emulator, not on a real phone yet; please try it and report any issues.

Redesigned phone pairing scanner: animated scan window in the app's colors, a success animation, a "Connecting to your computer" step, and clear messages with a paste-link option when the camera is blocked or missing. So far it has only been tested with a mocked camera; please try it on a real phone and report any issues.
Optional crash reports and anonymous usage stats in official builds, each with its own switch in Settings; prompts, code, file paths and keys are never included.
Providers already set up in the Supercharge CLI show up in Studio on connect (desktop and phone), marked Imported from CLI; keys stay in the CLI.
Type a custom model id in the picker when the list is empty or the model you want is missing; customs persist and send over ACP.
Tables in chat, a file tree that shows every file, and editor-style syntax highlighting for code blocks and the file viewer.
Prompt library, @-mentions of chats, checkpoints with undo, running tasks, rules and MCP editors, chat export and share links, scheduled runs, text size, phone quick actions and memory upkeep.
In-app updates: downloads and installs in the background, then restarts on one click.
Model picker stays after provider setup; Studio no longer locks the CLI to one model.
Provider setup in the app, matching the CLI setup on desktop and phone.
Side panel tabs fill the full height; terminals are tabs in the main tab row.
Plan approval, file tree, multiple terminals, folder picker and a new logo.
No firewall prompts in Public mode; updated protocol names.
No console windows from background helpers on Windows.
